verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Ardent that users can delegate tasks to. It only shows Ardent serving external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) through branch URLs, the CLI, and an ardent-cli skill installed into those agents. These are integrations for third-party agents, not a first-party assistant, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
